items.name: Cloak of the Reopened Mine
items.lore: Slate grey, with the Hibernian knot in silver thread. Sewn at the mine for those who took it back.

items.name: Moon-Silver Torc
items.lore: Moon-silver from the reopened workings, quieted by the Rowan. It hums, very softly.

items.name: Shaft-Silver Ring
items.lore: Plain silver from the main working. The smith left the pick-marks in.

items.name: Pick-and-Hammer Bracer
items.lore: Worn by the Wardens who reopened the mine. Scuffed, every one.

items.name: Dergal's Silver Helm
items.lore: Dergal's war-helm, beaten into a gorget. The sheevra will know it.

draughts: Dark, bitter, and good for what ails you. Mostly.
Not actually lamp oil. Probably. Clears the head.
A pinch of silver dust in honey-wine. The miners swear by it.
For when the roof comes down. Fast.
Thick enough to stand a pick in. Everything comes back a little faster.
